# pharmacist.com

> The American Pharmacists Association (APhA) professional community hub for pharmacy education, membership, continuing education, and career advancement.

pharmacist.com serves as the central platform for the American Pharmacists Association, offering membership programs across multiple professional categories, access to peer-reviewed journals (JAPhA, Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences), continuing education credits (ACPE), and networking opportunities through practice communities and leadership roles. The site supports pharmacists, students, technicians, researchers, and supporters with tailored resources for professional development and advocacy.

## Key Topics

- American Pharmacists Association (APhA)
- Membership Benefits
- Continuing Education (ACPE Credits)
- JAPhA (Journal of the American Pharmacists Association)
- Career Development
- Professional Publications
- Practice Communities
- Student Pharmacists
- Pharmacy Technicians
- Networking and Engagement
- Professional Advocacy
- Career Advancement
- Pharmacy Resources
- Member-Only Access
- Leadership Opportunities

## Membership Programs

- [Home](http://www.pharmacist.com): APhA homepage showcasing pharmacy advocacy, education programs, and membership opportunities
- [Join](http://www.pharmacist.com/join): APhA membership signup page with pricing options for pharmacists and students
- [Member Benefits](https://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Explore-Benefits): Overview of APhA membership benefits, categories, and professional development opportunities
- [Member Benefits](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits): Detailed member benefits including JAPhA journal access, ACPE credits, and advocacy

## Membership Categories

- [Pharmacists](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits/Pharmacists): Pharmacist membership benefits including continuing education and professional publications
- [Student Pharmacists](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits/Student-Pharmacists): Student membership benefits with access to Pharmacy Today, JAPhA, and career resources
- [New Practitioners](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits/New-Practitioners): New practitioner membership benefits for career development and professional resources
- [Pharmacy Technicians](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits/Pharmacy-Technicians): Pharmacy technician membership benefits with training programs and professional resources
- [Researchers](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits/Researchers): Researcher membership benefits including journal access and postgraduate training
- [Supporters](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Member-Benefits/Supporters): Supporter membership benefits with publication access and professional discounts

## Community & Engagement

- [Home - APhA ENGAGE](https://engage.pharmacist.com): APhA ENGAGE networking platform for member community and professional networking
- [Communities (Practice Interests)](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Communities-Practice-Interests): APhA practice communities for pharmacists in academia, ambulatory care, and specialties
- [Get Involved](http://www.pharmacist.com/Membership/Get-Involved): Ways to engage with APhA through leadership, advocacy, networking, and community apps

## Leadership & Resources

- [Chapter Officer Resources](https://www.pharmacist.com/membership/communities-practice-interests/student-pharmacists/chapter-officer-resources): APhA-ASP chapter officer resources including operations manual and leadership training
